observations: Photo 0 shows two handheld electric irons: one dark green, one pinkish-beige, placed in front of a product box labeled 'Mini Iron'.

The pinkish-beige iron has a visible power button and a dial, with a white cord attached.
A manual is visible to the right, with Chinese text '使用说明书' (User Manual) and '迷你电熨斗 2005' (Mini Electric Iron 2005).
The green iron appears to have a similar design but lacks visible controls in the photo.
The box does not show a brand name, only 'Mini Iron' and usage images.
The manual's model number '2005' does not match the seller's claim of 'Dyd 001'.

The box and manual do not mention lint removal. The product is labeled as a 'Mini Iron' for steam and dry ironing. No visual evidence of lint removal function is present.
